capabilities: Open a separate home view from the ribbon
Browse vault contents in folder columns
Choose which top-level folders are shown
Add or remove notes from a quick-access list
Mark top-level folders and first-level items with colored bars
disambiguation: Not a homepage note or template; the home page is a separate view and is not written as a Markdown note.
extras: Installed manually from a release zip; requires Obsidian 1.12.4 or later; the quick-access list is kept separate from core bookmarks.
problem: Obsidian has no dedicated home screen for browsing folders column by column and jumping quickly to frequently used notes.
summary: Adds a separate home view that browses the vault in folder columns, with configurable top-level folders and a quick-access note list.
